summary: REQUEST_CHANGES。D1 的零速率前置过滤使 GSL/新 ISL 决策按 time_step 轮询而非认证 crossing 恢复，可改变 deadline fate；D2 真正 matcher 对 W-only/单平面违反 E/W 跨面合同；rematch 会把未开始服务的 learning forward 包回退 pending，却保留未结算 transition，后续重决策可 KernelError；constant 模式仍强制验证/初始化 RF，违反设计。receipt、基础队列账目和 retired-link 结算路径基本闭合。

findings.summary: FACT: D1 zero-rate 在 uplink/downlink preselection 和 fresh ISL decision 被 time_step polling 截获，绕过 _transmit 的 certified rate-recovery race；INFERENCE: crossing 位于 tick 之间时可改变 latency、queue area 乃至 deadline fate。

FACT: D2 built-in cross-plane matcher immediately returns no cross edges when E is absent, so legal W-only config silently loses W links; num_planes=1 also permits same-plane E/W candidates despite the different-plane contract. Existing tests bypass this matcher with scripted neighbors_at.

FACT: rematch 把 old ISL data_q 包移入 pending 时不处理尚未结算的 learning forward transition；_learning_action 明确拒绝 non-deliver action 的 state!=None/reward=None。INFERENCE: dynamic topology + learning 在后续合法重决策时可抛 KernelError。
FACT: design 要求 constant 模式忽略 RF，但 config 无条件验证 mcs_table/三套 RF，Kernel 也无条件构造 RF 与 recovery ranges；现有测试甚至把 constant+非法 RF 应失败固定下来，正式设计与实现/测试相冲突。

FACT: tests do not implement several stated acceptance checks: no exact analytic one-hop MCS timing, no off-tick GSL recovery race, no real Constellation rematcher boundary tests, and rematch migration test does not continue through ledger conservation or learning redecision.

recommendedActions: F1: 统一 zero-rate scheduling：使 uplink/downlink/fresh-ISL 路径使用 certified next_*_range_under crossing，并增加 crossing 位于两个 time_step 之间且 deadline 位于下一 tick 之前的解析测试。
F2: 修正或收紧 E/W dynamic matching 合同；对真实 Constellation 添加 W-only、E-only、E+W、单平面和多平面测试，非法组合应 config fail-loud。
F3: 明确定义 queued forward action 因 topology retirement 未实现时的 learning transition fate/reward；用 qlearning 做 rematch-before-service 端到端测试并验证 transition accounting。
F4: 在代码和正式设计之间二选一并统一：若 constant 真正忽略 RF，则仅 mcs 模式验证/初始化 RF；若要改变合同，先修改设计再修改测试预期。
补充 end-to-end D2 registered-packet rematch 测试，至少验证 packet conservation、holding/ISL queue-area 迁移、control drain 和 retired-link stop accounting。
本地 Agent 在允许扩大路径后核查 dynamic rematch 是否会重置同一 sat:direction 的 Gilbert-Elliott trajectory。
openItems: F1 major remains open: locally reproduce an off-tick rate crossing and deadline race for uplink/downlink/fresh ISL decisions, then fix or formally redefine recovery scheduling.
F2 major remains open: repair or reject W-only/E-only and num_planes=1 dynamic cross-plane configurations; verify with the real Constellation matcher rather than scripted neighbors_at.
F3 major remains open: define and test learning-transition handling when a queued forward is retired by topology rematch before service starts.
F4 major remains open: reconcile the formal constant-mode RF-ignore contract with unconditional config validation and Kernel RF initialization.

UNVERIFIED: new ISLLink objects recreate GilbertElliott using the same isl:{sat}:{direction} stream key; continuity/reset semantics cannot be established without reading the currently unauthorized outage/RNG implementation.
